attempt.message: stat remote: No such file or directory

diagnosis: OpenSSH sftp put -a resumes an existing remote file but does not create a fresh remote target. The v1 transfer contract incorrectly required append mode for the initial transfer.
scientific_impact: none; no remote byte, tool execution, dependency resolution, model access, dataset access, or numerical evidence was produced
decision: Reject v1 transfer command semantics. Retain the same recovery identity and fresh paths under a superseding v2 contract that uses put for initial creation and put -a only for a verified partial prefix after interruption.
prohibited_actions: editing or relabeling the v1 prefreeze
claiming that any asset reached the server
using append mode when the remote target is absent
changing the official release identity or local accepted assets
installing dependencies or starting any downstream stage
